title: AI receptionist for US dental clinics

source.text: AI receptionist that answers missed calls and books appointments for US dental clinics, 199 USD a month per clinic. Country: United States. Budget: 2000 USD. Goal: a side business reaching 5k USD MRR within 12 months. Founder: solo developer, 10 hours a week, no dental network. Places to post: r/SideProject and X. Just go: do not ask questions.

problem: Dental clinics miss calls, and each missed call can be a lost new patient.
solution: An AI receptionist that answers missed calls and books appointments.
assumptions: Headless run ('just go'): no questions asked; every gap below is an assumption.
Booking writes into the clinic's practice-management system through Open Dental's API or NexHealth; Dentrix direct integration is out of budget.
A clinic sends about 450 AI-handled minutes a month (300-600 range); not measured.
Monthly churn 6%, from SMB SaaS benchmarks (3-7%) and a critic's 3-6 month stays.
The voice stack is Retell with its BAA; Vapi's HIPAA add-on (~$1,000-2,000/month) is not used.
Goal of 5k USD MRR means about 26 paying clinics at 199 USD.
unknowns: which practice-management systems the target clinics run
who signs the purchase (owner dentist or office manager)
real minutes per clinic per month

answers.question: Do you already have an audience, list or customers among US dentists?
answers.answer: No dental network (stated); posting places are r/SideProject and X.

answers.answer: Side business reaching USD 5k MRR within 12 months (stated).
